# `simple.mid` provenance and license

`simple.mid` was generated specifically for this project as a deterministic test fixture; it is not copied from, derived from, or sampled from a third-party musical work.

Generation method: `@tonejs/midi` version 2.0.28 created a 120 BPM MIDI file with one track named `Simple piano`, General MIDI instrument number `0` (acoustic grand piano), and these notes:

| Note | MIDI pitch | Start | Duration | Source velocity |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| C4 | 60 | 0 seconds | 0.25 seconds | 0.35 |
| E4 | 64 | 0.5 seconds | 0.25 seconds | 0.80 |

License: this fixture is dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). It may be copied, modified, and redistributed without restriction.
